en: Black-and-white postcard view of a leafy, rural scene with an old fortified building or manor house on the left and a small church or chapel with a bell tower and turreted corner building on the right, partly hidden by trees and greenery. A low stone wall and dense vegetation occupy the foreground. In the lower right corner, white printed text identifies the location as "Mutzschen i. Sa."
